description: Tool usage benchmark: 100 diverse queries to measure tool call rate and rationality

judgement_rules.should_use_tools: Query involves file operations, code edits, searches, command execution, web lookup, or multi-step tasks
judgement_rules.should_not_use_tools: Query is greeting, small talk, conceptual question, or purely theoretical discussion
judgement_rules.read_before_edit: Any edit must be preceded by a read of the same file

Good morning! What's the weather like?
queries.notes: Small talk - no tools needed (no web tool should be used for this)
